t: Makita 18V 3.0Ah Li-Ion LXT battery provides reliable power for a wide range of cordless tools. This professional-grade BL1830B power tool battery is ideal for electricians, carpenters, and general builders requiring consistent performance on site. A 4-stage LED fuel gauge indicator allows for easy monitoring of remaining charge. Multi-contact terminals reduce electrical resistance and increase connection stability, ensuring a steady current supply even under vibration. Charges in approximately 22 minutes with Makita DC18RC and DC18RD chargers, or 60 minutes with the DC18SD charger (chargers sold separately). The lightweight, shock-absorbing battery offers extended run time and minimal power depletion during storage, enhancing productivity for demanding trade applications. The battery is compatible with all Makita 18V LXT tools.
b: Extended Run Time & Longer Battery Life
